title: Tech Gifts for Grandparents and Parents Over 55
description: Easy, useful tech gifts for grandparents and older parents: digital photo frames, smart displays, e-readers, video doorbells and watches with fall detection.
intro: Simple, genuinely useful gadgets that keep families connected, with tips on setting them up before you give them.

sections.h2: Make it easy from day one
sections.html:
• Set it up before you wrap it: connect it to Wi-Fi, create accounts and load photos or books.
  • Pick big, clear screens and adjustable text sizes (e-readers and smart displays do this well).
  • Safety features help: Apple Watch offers fall detection and emergency SOS; video doorbells let people see who’s calling first.
  • Check subscriptions so they aren’t surprised by a bill later.

faqs.q: What is the best tech gift for a grandparent who isn’t techy?
faqs.a: A Wi-Fi digital photo frame that family members send pictures to, or a smart display for easy video calls, are popular because they need almost no effort once set up.
